core_claim: The Cold-War duopoly that defined the space age is over — in 2018 China launched more orbital rockets than anyone else and nearly half of all launches were flown by private firms.
tension: Most readers still picture space as a US-vs-Russia story; the data says that picture is sixty years out of date.
payoff: Reframes orbital launch from Cold-War nostalgia to live 21st-century industrial geopolitics, with China overtaking the US and SpaceX out-launching small national programmes.
